programmes.d: Henry and Ray get a copy of the new Kid Danger and Captain Man cartoon and see that it's horrible; they must hurry to fix the cartoon before the big premiere party.
When a suspicious new student arrives at school, Charlotte and Henry believe he's up to something; Captain Man comes in disguised as a substitute teacher to find out more.
When a dangerous piñata winds up at a child's birthday party, Kid Danger and Captain Man must go undercover to step in before it is too late.
Lincoln has a plan to get the best seat in the car for a long road trip; Lincoln needs to prove he is mature so he can sit at the adult table.
Lincoln spills one of Lisa's experiments, setting off a chain reaction throughout the house; Lincoln tries to encourage the family to stop using so much electricity.
Luna learns Chunk was like her in high school and worries her ambition to be a rocker is unrealistic; Lincoln wages war after his food is filched from the refrigerator.
Lincoln has his hands full when all 10 of his sisters ask him to cover for them on the same day; Bobby and Lori go on a double date with Lincoln and Bobby's little sister, Ronnie Anne.
When Liam fills in as a reporter, the school soon falls in love with Liam's life on Hunnicutt Farms; when Lynn is scouted for her athletic prowess, she soon becomes a professional wrestler.

Leni must protect her mannequin friend Tanya when her boss, Ms. Carmichael, decides to update Reininger's; when Dante buries a secret in The Royal Woods Cemetery, he must stop the Morticians Club from discovering what it is.
When Luan is cast as the lead role and detective in the play, she ends up solving a real case.

Lincoln worries that he has lost his manliness from growing up with sisters, so he and Clyde decide to go camping; Lincoln gets Lori a job at a pizza arcade, but Lori gets in trouble when he starts to ask for favors.
Lincoln's sisters accidentally get him four dates for the Sadie Hawkins dance at school; when Lincoln and Bobby become friends, Lori sets out to make Bobby jealous by spending time with Clyde.
The older sisters reluctantly let Lynn into their baby-sitting club, but she quickly proves to be too aggressive; Ronnie Anne's grandparents decide to spy on her when she wants to go downtown.

Lincoln begins spending time at Clyde's house when Clyde's fathers give him more attention than he gets at home; when Lincoln wins a ride in a limo, he begins to change after getting a taste of the good life.
Lincoln tries to game the family gift swap and ends up learning a valuable lesson; a Scrooge-like Flip is visited by three ghosts in a take on "A Christmas Carol."

SpongeBob and his friends are swept away by a giant wave and find themselves stranded on a remote tropical island; to get back to Bikini Bottom, they need to learn how to surf from enigmatic surf guru Jack Kahuna Laguna.
Squidward turns into a giant after he is sprayed with plant growth spray; Patrick decides that he wants a nose.

When his friends become obsessed with Rock's friend, Potato, Paper tries to win back their attention; when Rock, Scissors and Pencil learn that Paper dislikes fart jokes, they search for one that'll make him laugh.
When Rock's dad comes to town, Rock joins the family business in an attempt to finally impress his father; after receiving a glitter bomb in the mail, Rock vows revenge on the anonymous bomber.
Timmy gets caught in the middle of a feud between Chester and A.J.; Timmy's mother starts predicting the weather.
Timmy wishes his father had a cooler job; Timmy enters the Dimm-a-dance Film Festival to impress Trixie Tang.
Cosmo is chosen to be the host of the secret fairy convention; Timmy sends Wanda to a spa for a day off.
Vicky advertises on the radio; Mark Chang seeks Timmy's help in defeating an alien race.
An evil dentist steals the teeth of a teen singing sensation; Timmy travels back in time to the Old West.
Timmy wishes to eliminate rules; an old friend visits Timmy.

Timmy writes Trixie an email asking her to go to the school dance, but Cosmo and Timmy's parents add their own terrible improvements and send it. Timmy must then venture into the Internet to prevent the email from reaching Trixie's computer.
Timmy needs help pulling the ultimate April Fools' Day prank; Timmy wishes for a way to stop the day at any point he wants to start over.
Timmy realizes he is not the only one with fairy godparents; Timmy opens a lemonade stand.
A dragon abducts Vicky when Timmy and his friends visit the Middle Ages; Timmy's parents become superheroes.
Nasty Vicky has magic on her side and revenge on her mind; Timmy wishes for a reset button for his life so he can get do-overs.
Timmy makes a wish for Chester; Timmy becomes a girl for the day in order to think of the perfect gift for Trixie.
Timmy becomes invisible, causing havoc at school; Timmy, Cosmo and Wanda try to trick anti-fairies back into Fairyworld.
Timmy trades places with Cosmo and Wanda; Timmy gets into trouble when the bike he wished for becomes jealous.
Timmy wishes his life was like an action movie; Timmy turns into a genius just in time to take a test.
Timmy wishes himself doll-sized for an adventure with his action figure; Timmy's parents suspect he is shoplifting.
Vicky kidnaps a teen singing sensation; Timmy challenges Vicky for the title of Queen of the Skatepark.

When Poof comes home for spring break, Chloe gets to baby-sit him while Cosmo and Wanda go out for dinner.

SpongeBob and his friends are swept away by a giant wave and find themselves stranded on a remote tropical island; to get back to Bikini Bottom, they need to learn how to surf from enigmatic surf guru Jack Kahuna Laguna.
Miss Priss has Krabby Patties banned from Bikini Bottom; SpongeBob's clumsy cousin visits.
Squidward is outraged when he sees Squilliam on a TV show about fancy homes; Plankton forms a rock band with SpongeBob, Patrick and Squidward.
Mr. Krabs becomes obsessed when he thinks that SpongeBob has found a penny; SpongeBob tries to memorize the history of boating in one night.
Plankton builds a coliseum and holds a gladiator show; SpongeBob and Patrick keep Squidward from concentrating on his music.
SpongeBob makes it his mission to become normal; SpongeBob wakes to find that everyone in Bikini Bottom is gone.
SpongeBob tries to remove a splinter before Mr. Krabs learns about it and sends him home early; SpongeBob and Patrick get new slide whistles and keep playing them, much to the annoyance of Squidward.
The Star family is a superhero team; Cecil works as a security guard at Lady Upturn's art museum.
The Stars' pet toilet Tinkle has puppies; the Star family spends a day playing at the cemetery.
Henry is grounded after he is caught sneaking out at night; while Piper drives Henry crazy at home, Charlotte steps into the sidekick role.
When Kid Danger is almost badly injured on a mission, Henry decides to go through the Densitizer to become indestructible like Captain Man.
When Charlotte is challenged to a fight at school, Captain Man and Kid Danger step in to try and help Charlotte defend herself.
Dr. Minyak challenges Captain Man to a spelling bee.
When Henry's dad gets an offer for a new job in Bordertown, Henry and Ray go undercover to try and stop him from getting the job and prevent Henry from having to move.
When the Toddler takes control of the Man Cave, Charlotte and Jasper have to find a way to sneak in and free Kid Danger and Captain Man.
